highlights.title: kwant bots on your phone, no app store
highlights.text: Settings › All spaces now starts with a card: scan its QR code with your phone, add kwant bots to the Home Screen, and turn on notifications.

highlights.title: Team chips that name the team once
highlights.text: The Ask: row's team chip reads "@Booktun.ing Team" without "(Team)", a long team name stays inside its pill on a phone too, and after Approve your keyboard lands back in the message box.

highlights.title: A reply stays put when it lands
highlights.text: Once a bot starts writing, the steps it took fold into one row under the reply, so the words don't jump when it finishes. Open the row to see every step.

fixes: In Manage team, "Pick a repo" always puts the cursor in Repo URL, even when kwant is busy.
The island's Allow once works for drafts and notes that mention a release or merge; commands and branches still need the card.
After a failed step, "Let me know which one you want to keep" or "…, or which file to use" now shows Blocked.
On Claude, a bot stops repeating a Bash or Read call that failed 3 times the same way, as it already does for kwant's tools.
The island says "Reading contract.md", never the folders around the file; the chat keeps its short path.
Import history, check times and goal tooltips read dates one way ("Nov 15, 3:42 PM"), and terminal log times stay on one line.
A bot that can't get a file itself asks you to drop it into the chat and uploads it on the page, instead of handing you the page.
Keep going quotes only your own messages, never a bot's or a customer's, and passes their words on marked as theirs.
Writes named like reads, such as retrying a payment or posting a status, keep the island's full card; plain reads keep Allow once.
